svg.title: 15,193 members in the nf-core Slack
svg.desc: A Slack window showing the #announcements channel. A message from nf-core says: We passed 15,000 members. Each square is one of you, coloured by the year you joined. Below it, 15,193 small squares grouped by join year: 2018: 54, 2019: 285, 2020: 704, 2021: 1,245, 2022: 2,084, 2023: 3,521, 2024: about 3,106, 2025: about 2,419, 2026: 1,775.

g.text: 🎉 We passed 15,000 members. Each square is one of you, coloured by
≈ estimated across a gap in the stats
